decisive_items: An MRI of the hips and pelvis then demonstrated bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement and a left-sided insertional tendinopathy
response.rationale: The MRI findings specifically mention insertional tendinopathy, which directly supports the diagnosis of Iliopsoas tendinopathy

rejected.why: Epidural abscess was ruled out by MRI findings
Cauda equina syndrome was not supported by MRI findings
Lack of definitive evidence for crystal arthropathy
